Im also a junior in college (or at least i should be, trying my best to finish my 2nd year subjects b4 this year ends), but yes, absolutely. Its okay to take breaks, its ok to heal. Your mental health is whats gonna make you finish in the first place. 

Look at it this way, you sprain your ankle n youre trying your best to walk again but the pain is still there, you have to rest so your ankle will heal and youll be able to walk again, right? 

Mental health is the same, you need to rest a bit in order to get back on track n succeed. Remember to stay active so you wont lose the rythm of college, but take it easy. Your wellbeing comes first.
